nodes.name: Yield curve bootstrap
nodes.note: Discount and forward curves from deposits, futures and swaps.

nodes.name: Implied volatility surface
nodes.note: Arbitrage-free interpolation of listed option quotes (for example SVI).

nodes.note: Path simulation with a standard error on every price.

nodes.note: Antithetics and control variates: the same accuracy with far fewer paths.

nodes.note: Sobol sequences with a Brownian bridge.

nodes.note: All first-order sensitivities for a small multiple of one pricing.

nodes.name: Black-Scholes
nodes.note: Lognormal spot, constant volatility: the reference model.

nodes.name: Bates
nodes.note: Heston with jumps, for short-dated skew.

nodes.name: Stochastic local volatility
nodes.note: Leverage function on top of Heston.

nodes.name: Black and Bachelier
nodes.note: Market quoting models for caps and swaptions.

nodes.name: Hull-White
nodes.note: Gaussian short rate fitted to today's curve.

nodes.name: Hazard rates and CDS
nodes.note: Default intensities bootstrapped from CDS quotes.

nodes.name: Monte Carlo VaR
nodes.note: Simulated risk factors, full or proxy revaluation.

nodes.name: Mean-variance
nodes.note: Convex portfolio optimisation, solved well classically.

nodes.name: Portfolio with discrete constraints
nodes.note: Cardinality and lot sizes: a mixed-integer problem.

nodes.name: Classical scenario generators
nodes.note: Copulas, then VAE, GAN or diffusion models.

nodes.name: Exposure and PFE
nodes.note: Expected and potential future exposure profiles.

nodes.note: Quadratic Monte Carlo speed-up; needs fault-tolerant hardware.

nodes.name: QAOA portfolio
nodes.note: Discrete portfolio selection as a QUBO.

nodes.name: Born machine
nodes.note: Quantum generative model for return distributions.

nodes.name: Inflation indexes

nodes.name: Flat curve
nodes.note: Single continuously compounded rate: the test and teaching curve.

nodes.name: Interpolated curves
nodes.note: Discount, zero or forward curves on given nodes, with a choice of interpolation.

nodes.name: Multi-curve bootstrap
nodes.note: Joint bootstrap of OIS discounting and IBOR forwarding curves.

nodes.name: Fitted bond curves
nodes.note: Parametric curves fitted to bond prices.

nodes.name: Spreaded curves
nodes.note: A base curve plus a spread: basis, credit or scenario shocks.

nodes.name: Implied and composite curves
nodes.note: Forward-starting curves and curves combined from two others.

nodes.name: Ultimate forward rate
nodes.note: Extrapolation towards a long-term rate, as in Solvency II.

nodes.name: Constant volatility
nodes.note: One number for every strike and expiry.

nodes.name: FX delta surface
nodes.note: FX volatility quoted by delta, as the market does.

nodes.name: Heston-implied surface
nodes.note: The Black surface a calibrated Heston model implies.

nodes.name: Andreasen-Huge interpolation
nodes.note: Arbitrage-free interpolation of option quotes, giving both implied and local volatility.

nodes.name: Dupire local volatility surface
nodes.note: Local volatility derived from the implied surface.

nodes.name: Swaption volatility matrix
nodes.note: At-the-money volatility by expiry and swap tenor.

nodes.name: Swaption volatility cube
nodes.note: Adds the strike dimension to the matrix.

nodes.name: SABR and ZABR cubes
nodes.note: Swaption cube with a SABR or ZABR smile per expiry and tenor.

nodes.name: Caplet volatility stripping
nodes.note: Caplet volatilities stripped from cap quotes.

nodes.name: Inflation caplet volatility
nodes.note: Year-on-year inflation cap and floor volatility.

nodes.name: Interpolated smiles
nodes.note: Smile through market quotes with a chosen interpolation.

nodes.name: SABR smiles
nodes.note: SABR smiles, including the no-arbitrage variant.

nodes.name: ZABR smiles
nodes.note: SABR extension with control of the wings (short-maturity, local-vol and full finite-difference variants).

nodes.name: Kahale extrapolation
nodes.note: Arbitrage-free extrapolation of a smile into the wings.

nodes.name: Time-dependent Heston
nodes.note: Heston with piecewise-constant parameters for term structure.

nodes.name: Rough Heston
nodes.note: Fractional variance: steep short-dated skew with few parameters.

nodes.name: CEV
nodes.note: Constant elasticity of variance: skew from a power of spot.

nodes.name: Equity-rates hybrids
nodes.note: Stochastic volatility or Black-Scholes with Hull-White rates.

nodes.name: Black-Karasinski
nodes.note: Lognormal short rate on a tree.

nodes.name: Gaussian 1-factor (GSR, Markov functional)
nodes.note: Workhorse for Bermudan swaptions and exotics with time-dependent volatility.

nodes.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck
nodes.note: Mean reversion for commodity spot prices.

nodes.name: Kluge (OU with jumps)
nodes.note: Mean reversion with spikes, for power prices.

nodes.name: Trees and lattices
nodes.note: Binomial trees (CRR, Jarrow-Rudd, Leisen-Reimer, Tian, Trigeorgis, Joshi, equal probabilities) and short-rate trees.

nodes.name: Finite differences
nodes.note: PDE solvers in one to n dimensions (Douglas, Craig-Sneyd, Hundsdorfer, modified Craig-Sneyd schemes).

nodes.name: Longstaff-Schwartz
nodes.note: Regression Monte Carlo for early exercise: the classical benchmark for callable products.

nodes.name: American approximations
nodes.note: Closed-form or fixed-point approximations of the early-exercise premium.

nodes.name: Calibration and optimisers
nodes.note: Fitting model parameters to market quotes.

nodes.name: CVA and XVA
nodes.note: Credit, funding and capital valuation adjustments on exposure profiles.
